name: Carta de Naturalización por Residencia

requirements.blocker_text: Requires continuous legal residence (temporary or permanent resident card) for the 5 years immediately preceding the application.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 5 continuous years of legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing exams on Spanish language and knowledge of Mexican history and culture. Refugees, minors, and applicants over 60 need only pass the Spanish-language exam. Up to 2 attempts per exam, 15 days apart; after 2 failures, a 1-year wait applies before reapplying.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare for and pass the required exam(s).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires clean federal and local criminal background checks.

evidence_required.document: Temporary or permanent resident card (6+ months validity remaining)
Federal and local criminal background clearances
Declaration under oath of entries/exits over the prior 2 years

sources.title: Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE) -- Carta de naturalización por residencia: 5-year residence, exams, documents

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Mexico's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 with a detailed, specific requirements list including exact exam-retry rules. Kept as a SEPARATE route file from mx_naturalisation_marriage and mx_naturalisation_latinamerican_iberian (rather than folded into one OR-logic route) since SRE itself publishes these as three distinctly named, separately numbered trámites with materially different residence periods and eligibility criteria -- following the same convention used for Costa Rica's naturalisation build, and treated as the better fit here than Greece's single-file approach since Mexico's own government structures them as separate procedures rather than one process with alternative grounds.
